points.text: 1 similarity: both involve a (signalling), chemical / ligand / molecule ;
2 difference: endocrine chemical / hormone, travels in blood / circulatory system (but paracrine chemical travels by diffusion) ;
1 (ACh) travels a short distance by diffusion ;
2 across, synapse / synaptic cleft / neuromuscular junction ;
1 palmitate-exposed cells, release / secrete, molecule / chemical / substance ;
2 (this) molecule switches on stress genes in, new / other, muscle cells ;
3 molecule is not, destroyed / denatured, by, boiling / high temperature ;
5 molecule is, lipid / lipid-soluble / hydrophobic / non-polar ;
5 fewer / smaller, sarcomeres / myofibrils / myofilaments / mitochondria / ribosomes ;
